headline: A Synopsys patent discloses power-aware RNM synchronization across UPF and HDL descriptions
fact: U.S. patent US11797742B1, assigned to Synopsys, describes power-aware real-number modeling for dynamic mixed-signal verification. The disclosure detects mismatches between power-supply network and RTL HDL descriptions, generates runtime value converters for RNM analog boundaries, and can insert assertions to detect inconsistent supply values. This Event records a patent disclosure; publication does not establish customer use or product deployment.

sources.title: US11797742B1 — Power aware real number modeling in dynamic verification of mixed-signal integrated circuit design
sources.summary: The patent record identifies Synopsys as assignee, names the inventors, dates publication to October 24, 2023, and describes UPF/HDL power synchronization, runtime value conversion, and mismatch assertions at RNM boundaries.
